meta.measures: Whether a scored operation's claimed outcome matches later leak-site posting.
meta.why_this_can_mislead: A dead brand with busy operators is the scoreboard being precise, not wrong, which is why successor brands are counted separately and never added in. Victims are often published weeks after the attack, so the month boundary around an operation is soft. The series begins 2022-01, so earlier operations are unverifiable rather than successful. And leak-site posting is not the same as operating: a group can be active and quiet, or finished with a site still up. Nothing here overturns a score.
